quest.a-healthy-brew.back.journal: Eight strands of seaweed. Lionett is waiting for them.
quest.a-healthy-brew.done.journal: Lionett brewed her tea and taught you how to make it.
quest.a-healthy-brew.gather.journal: Lionett wants you to gather 8 seaweed for her tea.
quest.a-healthy-brew.title: A Healthy Brew
quest.a-lost-shipment.found.journal: You found Tobias alive at a campfire in the woods. The shipment is lost, but he still has Reinhard's letter.
quest.a-lost-shipment.search.journal: Reinhard sent his farmhand Tobias to deliver a shipment to Dionsburg. He hasn't returned. Look for Tobias in the forest to the east.
quest.a-lost-shipment.search.tracker: Find Tobias in the forest to the east
quest.a-lost-shipment.title: A Lost Shipment
quest.alpha-wolves-at-the-village.cull.j: Kill 5 alpha wolves around the village.
quest.alpha-wolves-at-the-village.done.j: Done. Reported back to the Village Healer.
quest.alpha-wolves-at-the-village.report: The alpha wolves are dealt with; the Village Healer waits by the campfire.
quest.alpha-wolves-at-the-village.title: Alpha Wolves at the Village
quest.back-to-the-pen.done.journal: Hans has his whole herd back, the three wanderers too.
quest.back-to-the-pen.flock.journal: Hans wants his sheep back in the pen beside his house. They will not follow me, but they run from anyone who comes close, so I have to walk them in from behind.
quest.back-to-the-pen.report.journal: Every last sheep is back in the pen. Hans will want to hear it.
quest.back-to-the-pen.strays.journal: The flock is home, but three of Hans's favourites are still out: Baabara by the wolves to the east, Woolliam on the beach among the crabs, Lambert by the falling rocks to the west.
quest.back-to-the-pen.title: Back to the Pen
quest.bandits-at-the-shrine.cull.journal: Kill 6 bandits at the camp east of the shrine.
quest.bandits-at-the-shrine.done.journal: Done. Reported back to the Emberkeeper.
quest.bandits-at-the-shrine.report.journ: The bandits are dealt with; the Emberkeeper waits at the shrine.
quest.bandits-at-the-shrine.title: Bandits at the Shrine
quest.bears-at-the-walls.cull.journal: Kill 5 bears near the city walls.
quest.bears-at-the-walls.done.journal: Done. Reported back to the City Guard.
quest.bears-at-the-walls.report.journal: The bears are dealt with; the City Guard waits at the gate.
quest.bears-at-the-walls.title: Bears at the Walls
quest.boars-in-the-field.cull.journal: Kill 6 of the boars who threaten the harvest on the fields north and south of miller Reinhard's mill.
quest.boars-in-the-field.done.journal: Reinhard's grain is safe, for now.
quest.boars-in-the-field.report.journal: The boars are dealt with. Reinhard is waiting.
quest.boars-in-the-field.title: The Problematic Boars
quest.clear-the-grove.cleared.journal: Done. Grandfather Knot's grove is clear.
quest.clear-the-grove.tidied.journal: The grove is clear. Grandfather Knot waits in the Glimmerwood.
quest.clear-the-grove.tidy.journal: Clear the deadwood from Grandfather Knot's grove with Harvest.
quest.clear-the-grove.title: Clear the Grove
quest.dire-wolves-at-the-camp.cull.journ: Kill 6 dire wolves around the Shaman's camp.
quest.dire-wolves-at-the-camp.done.journ: Done. Reported back to the Shaman.
quest.dire-wolves-at-the-camp.report.jou: The dire wolves are dealt with; the Shaman waits at his fire.
quest.dire-wolves-at-the-camp.title: Dire Wolves at the Camp
quest.dire-wolves-in-the-forest.cull.jou: Kill 4 dire wolves in the dark forest.
quest.dire-wolves-in-the-forest.done.jou: Done. Reported back to the Lamplighter.
quest.dire-wolves-in-the-forest.report.j: The dire wolves are dealt with; the Lamplighter waits at the forest edge.
quest.dire-wolves-in-the-forest.title: Dire Wolves in the Forest
quest.eliza-sends-me.done.journal: You told Reinhard that Flora sent you. There is plenty of work around here.
quest.eliza-sends-me.meet.journal: You have reached Reinhard's farm. Now to find the miller himself.
quest.eliza-sends-me.road.journal: Flora has no more work. She told you to talk to miller Reinhard, who lives further east.
quest.eliza-sends-me.title: Off to the Mill
quest.giant-rats-in-the-barn.clear.journ: Miller Reinhard tasked you to kill 8 of the rats that have infested the granary.
quest.giant-rats-in-the-barn.report.jour: The granary is quiet. Reinhard is waiting.
quest.giant-rats-in-the-barn.title: The Pest in the Granary
quest.he-who-cried-wolf.crier.journal: Hans is uneasy about so many wolves. He sent you to the Town Crier, close to Reinhard's farm.
quest.he-who-cried-wolf.done.journal: The Governor of Dionsburg has heard about the wolves.
quest.he-who-cried-wolf.governor.journal: The Town Crier advised you to tell the Governor of Dionsburg about the rising numbers of wolves in the farmlands. Maybe they know what causes it there.
quest.he-who-cried-wolf.governor.tracker: Talk to the Governor of Dionsburg
quest.he-who-cried-wolf.hunt.journal: The shepherd tasked you with killing 6 wolves that found their way to the farmlands.
quest.he-who-cried-wolf.report.journal: Six wolves are dead. Hans should hear of it.
quest.he-who-cried-wolf.title: He Who Cried Wolf
quest.kobolds-on-the-road.done.journal: Done. Reported back to the Wanderer.
quest.kobolds-on-the-road.report.journal: The kobolds are thinned; the Wanderer is on the road nearby.
quest.kobolds-on-the-road.title: Kobolds on the Road
quest.meat-for-dinner.home.journal: Five deer. Flora's pantry will be full again.
quest.meat-for-dinner.hunt.journal: Kill 5 deer for Flora's pantry. You'll find them south of the farm.
quest.meat-for-dinner.title: Meat for Dinner
quest.mushrooms-for-the-gnome.bring.jour: I have six blue mushrooms for the gnome at the south end of the swamp.
quest.mushrooms-for-the-gnome.bring.trac: Bring the mushrooms to the gnome in the south
quest.mushrooms-for-the-gnome.done.journ: Done. The gnome Fennick has his mushrooms.
quest.mushrooms-for-the-gnome.pick.journ: Hedda picks bog mushrooms for a gnome at the south end of the swamp, but her cough keeps her by the fire. She asked me to pick six blue mushrooms beside the planks in the dark heart of the swamp.
quest.mushrooms-for-the-gnome.title: Mushrooms for the Gnome
quest.oil-for-the-lamps.bring.journal: I have a flask of gnome lamp oil for the Lamplighter at the edge of the dark forest.
quest.oil-for-the-lamps.bring.tracker: Bring the lamp oil to the Lamplighter
quest.oil-for-the-lamps.done.journal: Done. The Lamplighter taught me to carry a lamp.
quest.oil-for-the-lamps.fetch.journal: The Lamplighter's lamps are dry, and nobody gets through the dark forest without a light. The gnomes in Dionsburg make the oil he needs.
quest.oil-for-the-lamps.fetch.tracker: Get lamp oil from the gnomes in Dionsburg
quest.oil-for-the-lamps.title: Oil for the Lamps
quest.ready-for-harvest.gather.journal: Harvest 10 beets on the field east of farmer Flora's house.
quest.ready-for-harvest.home.journal: The beets are harvested. Flora is waiting.
quest.ready-for-harvest.title: Ready for Harvest
quest.spiders-in-the-diggings.cull.journ: Kill 6 spiders in the tunnel diggings.
quest.spiders-in-the-diggings.done.journ: Done. Reported back to the Miner.
quest.spiders-in-the-diggings.report.jou: The spiders are dealt with; the Miner waits at the tunnel's west mouth.
quest.spiders-in-the-diggings.title: Spiders in the Diggings
quest.the-alpha-bear.hunt.journal: A great bear led the attack on the woodcutters' camp. It dens in a cave east of the camp. Fritz wants it dead.
quest.the-alpha-bear.title: The Alpha Bear
quest.the-captive.done.journal: Done. Fritz knows she is alive.
quest.the-captive.return.journal: She is alive, tied up on the plateau. Fritz should hear it.
quest.the-captive.search.journal: Fritz saw the kobolds drag one of his woodcutters up to their plateau in the north-west. She may still be alive.
quest.the-captive.search.talk_to.Woodcut: Find the captive woodcutter on the plateau
quest.the-captive.title: The Captive
quest.the-lost-friend.done.journal: Done. Fritz knows his scout is dead.
quest.the-lost-friend.return.journal: Fritz's scout lies dead at the edge of the dark forest, among the spiders.
quest.the-lost-friend.search.journal: Fritz's scout went south to look over the darker part of the forest for new timber and never came back.
quest.the-lost-friend.search.talk_to.Fal: Find Fritz's scout in the south
quest.the-lost-friend.title: The Lost Friend
quest.the-lost-lamp.bring-it-back.journa: The kobolds are dealt with; the Traveller waits at the tunnel mouth.
quest.the-lost-lamp.cull.journal: Kill 6 kobolds north of the tunnel.
quest.the-lost-lamp.title: The Lost Lamp
quest.the-millers-ring.return.journal: The ring was tangled in a heap of seaweed. Reinhard will want it back before his wife notices.
quest.the-millers-ring.search.journal: Find miller Reinhard's lost wedding ring on the beach north of the farm. It must be tangled in the seaweed washed up along the shore.
quest.the-millers-ring.search.tracker: Search the seaweed on the beach for the ring
quest.the-millers-ring.title: Lost and Found
quest.the-sleeping-roots.back-one.journa: The root by the stream is awake.
quest.the-sleeping-roots.back-two.journa: The root by the stones is awake.
quest.the-sleeping-roots.root-one.journa: Grandfather Knot's roots calm the treants of the Glimmerwood, but three of them have fallen asleep. Wake the root by the stream, west of him.
quest.the-sleeping-roots.root-one.talk_t: Wake the root by the stream
quest.the-sleeping-roots.root-three.jour: Wake the last root, east of Grandfather Knot where the wisps gather.
quest.the-sleeping-roots.root-two.journa: Wake the root by the stones, south of Grandfather Knot.
quest.the-sleeping-roots.root-two.talk_t: Wake the root by the stones
quest.the-sleeping-roots.title: The Sleeping Roots
quest.the-sounder-at-the-mill.cull.journ: Kill the leader of the boars. You'll find him in their den to the south.
quest.the-sounder-at-the-mill.cull.track: Kill the beast of the farmlands ({n, number}/{m, number})
quest.the-sounder-at-the-mill.done.journ: The beast is dead and the crops are safe.
quest.the-sounder-at-the-mill.report.jou: The beast of the farmlands is dead. Reinhard will want to hear it.
quest.the-sounder-at-the-mill.title: The Beast of the Farmlands
quest.the-spider-queen.bring.journal: The Spider Queen is dead and I have her venom.
quest.the-spider-queen.done.journal: Done. Fennick brewed his cure and gave me some.
quest.the-spider-queen.hunt.journal: Fennick brews a cure for the bog sickness. He needs venom from the Spider Queen, who lives in a den in the west of the swamp. He told me not to go alone.
quest.the-spider-queen.title: The Spider Queen
quest.the-stolen-shipment.deliver.journa: I have the shipment and Reinhard's letter. They belong to the gnomes in Dionsburg.
quest.the-stolen-shipment.deliver.tracke: Bring the shipment to the gnomes in Dionsburg
quest.the-stolen-shipment.done.journal: Done. The gnomes have their shipment.
quest.the-stolen-shipment.follow.journal: The bandits burned Tobias's cart, but kobolds dragged the crates off into the trees to the north-east. Follow the spilled cargo.
quest.the-stolen-shipment.recover.journa: The trail ends at the kobold cave behind the wrecked woodcutters' camp. Their chief holds the shipment up on the plateau.
quest.the-stolen-shipment.recover.tracke: Kill the kobold chief on the plateau
quest.the-stolen-shipment.title: The Stolen Shipment
quest.the-strays.done.journal: Hans has his herd back. More or less.
quest.the-strays.find.journal: Find the shepherd's lost sheep and his dog. They are somewhere around the farmlands.
quest.the-strays.report.journal: Baabara, Woolliam and Lambert are found, and the dog with them. Hans is waiting on the pasture.
quest.the-strays.title: A Herd Astray
quest.the-wolf-den.hunt.journal: A mean old alpha wolf dens in a cave to the south-west and hunts Fritz's woodcutters. Fritz wants it dead.
quest.the-wolf-den.title: The Wolf Den
quest.thin-the-orc-line.cull.journal: Kill 5 orcs on the front line to the south.
quest.thin-the-orc-line.done.journal: Done. Reported back to the Front Captain.
quest.thin-the-orc-line.report.journal: The orc line is thinned; the Front Captain waits at the staging area.
quest.thin-the-orc-line.title: Thin the Orc Line
quest.treasure-in-the-bog.done.journal: Done. Captain Brack has his chest, and I have my share.
quest.treasure-in-the-bog.find.journal: The pirates hid a chest in the bog before the spiders came. Captain Brack says it lies in the south of the swamp, past where the planks end.
quest.treasure-in-the-bog.find.talk_to.S: Find the pirates' chest in the bog
quest.treasure-in-the-bog.return.journal: I found the pirates' chest, sunk to its lid in the bog.
quest.treasure-in-the-bog.title: Treasure in the Bog
quest.turnip-chore.handover.journal: The turnips are gathered; the Farmer waits by his field.
quest.turnip-chore.paid.journal: Done. Reported back to the Farmer.
quest.turnip-chore.pull.journal: Harvest 5 turnips from the row north of the Farmer.
quest.turnip-chore.title: Turnip Chore
quest.village-welcome.back.journal: Reinhard and the Town Crier have been met; the Hermit waits nearby.
quest.village-welcome.known.journal: Done. Reported back to the Hermit.
quest.village-welcome.meet.journal: Talk to Reinhard and the Town Crier.
quest.village-welcome.title: Village Welcome
quest.wolves-on-the-road.carry-word.jour: The wolves are thinned; word should reach the City Guard at the city gate far to the east, or the Shaman at his fire east along the road.
quest.wolves-on-the-road.carry-word.trac: Report to the City Guard or the Shaman
quest.wolves-on-the-road.thin.journal: Kill 8 wolves on the west road.
quest.wolves-on-the-road.title: Wolves on the Road
quest.wolves-on-the-road.told-militia.jo: Done. Reported to the City Guard. Learned Taunt.
quest.wolves-on-the-road.told-shaman.jou: Done. Reported to the Shaman. Learned Slow.
